specializations.name: AI Voice Narration
specializations.inputs: Approved narration copy, intended audience and language, pronunciation notes, per-scene intent, desired voice character, licensed or consented voice choices, API budget, timeline and soundtrack constraints
specializations.decision: Produce an approved, scene-linked spoken performance through the OpenAI Speech API by default; define meaningful segments, voice, language, delivery instructions and revisions separately from mixing and synchronization.
specializations.mechanism: Segment-oriented synthesis and iterative listening can align intelligibility, narrative emphasis, pauses and character with the visual story while leaving the audio reproducible and editable.
specializations.tradeoff: Synthetic narration can mispronounce names or shift timing, emotion and voice identity across chunks; provider access, latency and API cost also constrain production. Speech output does not guarantee word timestamps.
specializations.verification: Listen to the entire generated voice track at actual speed, audit script coverage and pronunciation, measure the actual duration of every file, inspect segment joins, verify licensed provenance and AI disclosure, then check the combined video at beginning, middle and end.
specializations.output: Approved narration plan, generated voice stems, segment-level duration and provenance manifest, pronunciation review and handoff cues
specializations.evidence: OpenAI API interface verified from official documentation on 2026-11-09; creative and audibility mechanisms require project-specific listening and checks.

handoffs.condition: When a project requests spoken narration
handoffs.payload: Audience, message, language, delivery intent and disclosure requirements

handoffs.condition: When speech follows or shapes the sequence
handoffs.payload: Scene IDs, narrative beats and intended visual emphasis

handoffs.condition: When narration and other sounds coexist
handoffs.payload: Approved voice stems, narrative priority, pauses and voice-forward mixing target

handoffs.condition: When aligning spoken words to shots and motion
handoffs.payload: Measured stem durations, ordered segment IDs, offsets and audible pauses
Final spoken script and reviewed phrase anchors; not fabricated word timestamps
Phrase-level beats, intentional silences and emphasis points

handoffs.condition: When synthetic speech is in the deliverable
handoffs.payload: Audio provenance, voice settings, AI disclosure and editable audio files
Audibility, script accuracy, pronunciation, intelligibility and disclosure checks

handoffs.condition: When measured speech duration cannot fit approved visuals without harming comprehension
handoffs.payload: Timing conflict and segments proposed for re-performance
